verdict.rationale: Anrok's pricing page says 'Registration handled in every jurisdiction,' and the product shows a dashboard of 'automatic registration completion in 13 jurisdictions,' so in-product registration done on the seller's behalf with some status visibility is supported. However, nothing shows per-registration pricing, and the evidence is thin on how status tracking works and on local (versus state) registrations. Missing for 10: transparent per-registration pricing, explicit coverage of local registrations, detailed docs on registration status tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
